notes:
Takeoff the way it is done on every other takeoff tool: pick a condition, draw,
and every takeoff adds up to one number.

- **+ Condition** opens a setup screen: name it, pick **SF, LF or EA**, and
  choose its color, line thickness and opacity. Put it in a group and an area
  while you are there. A name the price book knows arrives priced.

- Draw with it and each takeoff adds to its total. The panel shows one row per
  condition (2,617 SF, $16,358.76), and the estimate prices it once. The ▸ on
  the row lists its takeoffs when you want to see or delete one.

- Picking a condition picks up the right tool. Its look belongs to it: change
  the color or line thickness in the tool panel, the color square, or the setup
  screen, and every takeoff redraws. A thickness turns a slab into cubic yards;
  a spacing turns a run into a count.

- **Groups** add conditions together: everything under one sub, or the footing
  in LF and the slab in SF as one concrete figure.

- **Areas**: put a condition or a whole group in Frontyard, Backyard, Kitchen.
  The estimate filters to one area and says what it comes to, and the totals
  break the bid down by area.

- Jobs measured the old way price exactly as they did.

Also fixed: the "delete group" question showed "[object HTMLDivElement]" over an
empty number box instead of its choices, and every yes/no question carried a
stray "look on / match" row.
